Roxas''', is a [[municipality of the Philippines|municipality]] in the [[Philippine Province|province]] of [[Zamboanga del Norte]], [[Philippines]]. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 38,649 people.{{PH wikidata|population_reference}} ==History== The municipality of President Manuel A. Roxas was first created from the municipality of [[Katipunan, Zamboanga del Norte|Katipunan]] in 1965 by President [[Diosdado Macapagal]] through Presidential Proclamation No. 177. However, its creation was questioned by Vice President [[Emmanuel Pelaez]], and was later reverted by the [[Supreme Court of the Philippines]] as one of Katipunan's barangays.{{cite web|url=http://www.zamboangadelnorte.com/Roxas.htm|title=Zamboanga del Norte : Municipality of Manuel A. Roxas|accessdate=November 21, 2020|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20021119102601/http://www.zamboangadelnorte.com/Roxas.htm|archivedate=November 19, 2002|url-status=dead}} On June 17, 1967, through the effort of [[Zamboanga del Norte's at-large congressional district|Zamboanga del Norte]] Representative Alberto Q. Ubay, Republic Act No. 5077 was lapsed into law without President [[Ferdinand Marcos]]'s signature, carving out President Manuel A. Roxas from Katipunan once more.{{cite web|url=https://laws.chanrobles.com/republicacts/51_republicacts.php?id=5081|title=Republic Act No. 5077|accessdate=November 21, 2020|website=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library}} ==Geography== ===Barangays=== President Manuel A. Roxas is politically subdivided into 31 [[barangay]]s.
